title: Chapter 6500: Fool
content:
Chapter 6500: Fool

Chapter 6500: Fool

“Is he dead?” One spectator asked since Li Qiye was nowhere to be found.

That slash was unstoppable. North Kun God himself thought he would have been killed, albeit not fully reduced to ashes.

Seventy-two and his allies became hopeful. Unfortunately, the greater the hope, the greater the disappointment.

“That’s all?” Li Qiye spoke.

The slash left behind immortal infernos. Li Qiye was perfectly fine, just out of sight while standing inside an inferno.

Trinity and the others became speechless.

“Claiming the title of immortal? How ignorant and foolish.” Li Qiye smiled and grabbed the blade used for the slash.

He looked like an ant walking on a colossal mountain range but easily dispelled it. The primal ancestors had no time to process this before being gifted a kick.

The immortal vessel immediately entered a defensive pose.

“Bam!” Cracks appeared everywhere as it was sent flying like a meteor toward the real world.

Meanwhile, those outside have been paying attention to the fluctuations in the dream world. A hole suddenly appeared and a giant flew out, smashing into the land.

Weaker cultivators and mortals fainted from the impact.

“A calamity?” Many viewed this as a meteor descending upon the largest desert in Old World - an abandoned area.

Not to mention emperors, even primal ancestors felt their legs shaking. The vessel might not be a true immortal but was definitely in the overlord realm.

No one saw anything unique or profound about the kick yet it sent the being through the world barriers.

Nevertheless, the vessel was tough. Its cracks disappeared in just a few seconds as it stood up again.

Its presence frightened everyone in Old World, especially its immortal rays. Many prostrated to show respect, thinking it might be an immortal descending.

“What is this thing?” Primal ancestors had no idea because they didn’t enter the dream world.

Normally, a supreme overlord didn’t visit with such fanfare and aura. The giant looked like it was preparing for a fight to the death, preparing to destroy the world with it.

“Not only are you suicidal, you’re dragging others down with you, fool.” Li Qiye spoke to Seventy-two inside the vessel.

“Fool, me?! I was the second primal ancestor in the world and reached the extinguishment stage. How many can compare to me?!” Seventy-two barked back.

His achievements were worthy of pride - a potential candidate for the overlord realm. Unfortunately, he couldn’t do it because Desolate Ancestor didn’t permit his ascension.

Was this man behind it all? The person who ruined his past, present, and future? The killer of his parents since he persuaded them to go against Moshi?

His hatred was bone deep as he stared at Li Qiye.

“These things didn’t prevent you from being a fool.” Li Qiye said.

“One of us will die today.” Seventy-two must obliterate Li Qiye to rid himself of mental weakness.

“Only you.” Li Qiye said.

“Summon!” He no longer cared and raised his hand to reach the treasury of Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect.

He took something out - the flame of a true immortal. Nothing could shake his confidence with it in his possession.
